title: Surveys & Related Lists
blurb: Surveys that cover world models, video generation, or interactive generation. Read these first to place a paper in context.

title: Foundations & Prehistory
blurb: Work that defined the problem before interactive video world models became a category of their own: latent world models, neural game engines, and playable video generation.

title: Blogs & Technical Reports
blurb: Systems that would sit in the main list if they had a paper. Announced through a blog post or technical report, documented well enough to place, and too important to leave out — every URL here has been checked by hand.

title: Interactive Video World Models
blurb: The main list: systems that meet all three criteria. Newest first.

title: Action Control & Interfaces
blurb: How an action reaches the generator: action spaces, injection mechanisms, latent actions learned without labels, and control-fidelity analysis.

title: Real-Time & Streaming Generation
blurb: Meeting the per-frame latency budget: causal and autoregressive backbones, few-step distillation, KV caching, and inference systems.

title: Long-Horizon Memory & Consistency
blurb: Keeping the world stable when the camera comes back: long context, explicit spatial and 3D memory, retrieval, and state persistence.

title: Benchmarks & Evaluation
blurb: Benchmarks and evaluation protocols aimed at interactive world models, including memory, control-following, and long-horizon stability.

title: Datasets & Environments
blurb: Action-annotated video corpora and simulators used to train and probe interactive world models.
